detail.description:
This role is ideal for an experienced
Python engineer
with hands-on experience building conversational AI agents and MCP-based integrations for end-user-facing products. You will develop reliable backend services and LLM-powered features used by real customers, collaborating with a senior-level engineering team.
Your responsibilities will include:
Build and improve conversational AI agents (multi-turn dialogue, tool/function calling, context management) for end-user-facing products.
Build and maintain Python-based MCP servers, clients, and integrations.
Develop backend APIs for LLM-powered products using FastAPI or FastMCP.
Work on prompting, tool integration, reliability, and production readiness of AI workflows.
Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable backend systems.
Collaborate with product and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality user-facing solutions.
Participate in improving system performance, stability, and maintainability.
Expand into modern LLM infrastructure and evaluation practices as needed.
What we expect from you:
English level B2 or higher for effective technical communication.
Strong hands-on experience with Python.
Hands-on production experience developing conversational agents or AI assistants.
Hands-on experience with MCP: building MCP servers, clients, or integrations, not just familiarity with the concept.
Experience working on end-user-facing products with real users, not only internal tooling or data pipelines.
Solid understanding of prompting and tool/function calling in LLM-based systems.
Proven backend engineering experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Experience designing and maintaining APIs and backend services.
Proficiency with Git and standard version control workflows.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
Nice to Have:
Exposure to Kubernetes.
Understanding of embeddings and evaluation (evals) workflows.
Familiarity with LLM inference concepts such as temperature, top_p, guardrails, and bias mitigation.
Experience with production-grade infrastructure and scalable services.
What we offer:
Interesting projects and challenges that accelerate professional and personal growth
Long-term project
15 paid vacation days per year
5 paid sick leave days per year
Flexible, results-focused schedule; hybrid work or remote (office with city view + work from home)
Comfortable, stylish office in Kyiv with generator/battery backup 🇺🇦
Equal salary, medical insurance, trial period
Team-building events: parties, online activities, picnics, and more
Opportunity to work in a Top-employee company (DOU 2025)
